case_number: 2025 INSC 434; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO.2137 OF 2025)
summary: Partition suit filed in 2023 over ancestral property allegedly partitioned orally in 1968; revenue records confirm mutation; registered sale deeds from 1978 provide constructive notice; plaintiffs failed to challenge transactions or allege date of knowledge; suit deemed barred by limitation; Trial Court's rejection under Order 7 Rule 11 CPC upheld; High Court's remand set aside; no triable issue survives due to delay and statutory notice.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure Order 7 Rule 11
Code of Civil Procedure Order 41 Rule 1
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment of High Court set aside; suit dismissed under Order 7 Rule 11 CPC upheld.
